file_stem: RWB TE 013 Agent runtime client with fallback
title: Agent runtime client with fallback
goal: One client calls an agent safely: the rule result applies, fallback is recorded, log first
why: Agents must never block or override a case step. In SHADOW or L1 the rule decides; the agent only adds a recommendation, within 60 seconds.
ace_note: No ACE read. Inputs are the case, the rule result already computed, and the agent policy in force.

writes.note: via P7 writer: agent_version, recommendation, fallback
links the run to the decision

functions.name: AgentStepClient
functions.does: the only way to call an agent

functions.name: AutonomyModeResolver
functions.does: OFF, SHADOW or L1 in force

path.text: Step acts on the rule result

rules: BR1: the rule result always applies in SHADOW and L1
BR2: a timeout records a fallback
BR3: the step acts only after the log entry is written
risks: No answer in 60 s -> fallback TIMED_OUT
Decision log write fails -> step does not act, EXCEPTION_QUEUE (MSG-P7-003)
example: INTAKE P1/PR1 in SHADOW on RW-2026-000201; rule R-UNI-32 v2026.11 -> RESUME_STATE
Log entry: agent_version 'INTAKE@P1/PR1', recommendation null, fallback false
